COMMUNITY SERVICE LEARNING — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #11
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: COMMUNITY SERVICE LEARNING
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Nakuru
   B. Mombasa
   C. Nairobi
   D. Kisumu

2. Which statement about Leadership Development is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Leadership Development with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Treat Leadership Development as rumours only.
   C. Say Leadership Development never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Leadership Development.

3. Which statement about Nurturing Empathy 2.2 Negotiation Skills 2.3 Building Consensus 3.0 Action Resea is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Nurturing Empathy 2.2 Negotiation Skills 2.3 Building Consensus 3.0 Action Resea as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Nurturing Empathy 2.2 Negotiation Skills 2.3 Building Consensus 3.0 Action Resea.
   C. Say Nurturing Empathy 2.2 Negotiation Skills 2.3 Building Consensus 3.0 Action Resea never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain Nurturing Empathy 2.2 Negotiation Skills 2.3 Building Consensus 3.0 Action Resea with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

4. Which statement about Building Consensus is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Building Consensus as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Building Consensus.
   C. Explain Building Consensus with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Say Building Consensus never happens in Kenya.

5. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Plan income and spending wisely
   B. Avoid saving forever
   C. Ignore prices in shops
   D. Hide all money underground

6. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Avoiding all community work
   B. Destroying road signs
   C. Obeying laws and caring for public property
   D. Littering in markets

7. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Replace the compass rose
   B. Measure rainfall only
   C. Name the president
   D. Explain symbols used on a map

8. Which statement about Building Consensus 3.0 Action Research 3.1 Problem Identification Process 3.2 Im is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Building Consensus 3.0 Action Research 3.1 Problem Identification Process 3.2 Im never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat Building Consensus 3.0 Action Research 3.1 Problem Identification Process 3.2 Im as rumours only.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Building Consensus 3.0 Action Research 3.1 Problem Identification Process 3.2 Im.
   D. Explain Building Consensus 3.0 Action Research 3.1 Problem Identification Process 3.2 Im with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

9. Which statement about Civic Dialogue 1.2 Advocacy in the Community 1.3 Leadership Development 1.4 Inte is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Civic Dialogue 1.2 Advocacy in the Community 1.3 Leadership Development 1.4 Inte with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Treat Civic Dialogue 1.2 Advocacy in the Community 1.3 Leadership Development 1.4 Inte as rumours only.
   C. Say Civic Dialogue 1.2 Advocacy in the Community 1.3 Leadership Development 1.4 Inte never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Civic Dialogue 1.2 Advocacy in the Community 1.3 Leadership Development 1.4 Inte.

10. Which statement about Negotiation Skills is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Negotiation Skills with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Negotiation Skills never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Negotiation Skills as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Negotiation Skills.

11. Which statement about Problem Identification Process 3.2 Implementation and Reflection 4.0 Social Entr is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Problem Identification Process 3.2 Implementation and Reflection 4.0 Social Entr.
   B. Treat Problem Identification Process 3.2 Implementation and Reflection 4.0 Social Entr as rumours only.
   C. Explain Problem Identification Process 3.2 Implementation and Reflection 4.0 Social Entr with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Say Problem Identification Process 3.2 Implementation and Reflection 4.0 Social Entr never happens in Kenya.

12. Which statement about Civic Dialogue is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Civic Dialogue.
   B. Say Civic Dialogue never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Civic Dialogue as rumours only.
   D. Explain Civic Dialogue with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Negotiation Skills and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Building Consensus 3.0 Action Research 3.1 Problem Identification Process 3.2 Im and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Building Consensus and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Problem Identification Process 3.2 Implementation and Reflection 4.0 Social Entr and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

====

1. C — Nairobi

2. A — Explain Leadership Development with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

3. D — Explain Nurturing Empathy 2.2 Negotiation Skills 2.3 Building Consensus 3.0 Action Resea with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

4. C — Explain Building Consensus with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

6. C — Obeying laws and caring for public property

8. D — Explain Building Consensus 3.0 Action Research 3.1 Problem Identification Process 3.2 Im with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

10. A — Explain Negotiation Skills with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Negotiation Skills; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

15. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Building Consensus; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

16. (4 marks)
